notes.title: Rewrite Harvest festa! now available on Steam!
notes.content:
What is Rewrite Harvest festa?
This is a collection of stories that weren't told in the main storyline of Rewrite. Includes 6 stories featuring the heroines of Rewrite. Also included is the unlockable, "Rewrite Quest", a first person-style dungeon crawler minigame.



Please Note: Rewrite Harvest festa! contains spoilers for Rewrite+ so please be sure to have completed Rewrite+ prior to playing Rewrite Harvest festa!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856600/Rewrite_Harvest_festa?snr=2___"][/dynamiclink]

Haven't tried Rewrite+ yet? It is also on sale this week as part of the Steam Week Long Deal! Save 60% off till July 21, 2025.
